integrity: Two exact exhaustive prefix enumerators agree on every cubefree level through length 22. Every candidate is independently tested under all single-bit changes by whole-word cube scans, and the symmetry orbits are recomputed exactly.
scientific_limitations: The published admissible-length spectrum is prior work. The new claim is the complete census at lengths 20,21,22: counts 2,4,2 and one reversal/complement orbit at each length. Later admissible lengths are not classified here. Unpublished source-author search output could contain the same census.
title: Complete census of the first delicate cubefree binary block
